root_cause.archive_source: existing split S2 archive read-only, independent rasterio MemoryFile decode, no extraction

writer.record_coupling: id caption tile and all 12 native uint16 arrays move together under any sort
writer.per_patch_sha256: canonical band order, band name + dtype + shape + contiguous uint16 bytes; source-read before shard write
writer.regression: synthetic archive arrival order differs from selection order; old code must fail and fixed code pass; zero row/pixel mismatches

verifier.raw_sample_rule: at least max(100,40*ceil(shards/10)) distinct shard rows, spread across shard groups, fixed seed 26170

rebuild_plan.label: projection from user-specified rate, not a measured rebuild

training_audit.B1: caption tokens only, EOS included, padding ignored
training_audit.B2: frozen fp16 base, fp32 trainable masters, autocast and GradScaler
training_audit.B3: three distinct LRs, cosine 3% warmup from planned total, accumulation boundaries
training_audit.B4: vision requires_grad and labeled T4 peak memory estimate
training_audit.B5: adapter, full patch embed, unfrozen vision, optimizer, scaler, scheduler, RNG, data state, step and checkpoint size
training_audit.B6: CPU mocked continuous loss/LR/data order across resume
training_audit.B7: wall guard saves and clean exit; eval shard only no_grad same preprocessing; throughput required
training_audit.B8: package source hash equals repo; requirements no torch install and accelerate pin

scope: no commit/push/upload/Kaggle/training/GPU/deletes/downloads/shard rebuild; contract/split/init/pinned checkpoint/eval shard unchanged
failed_attempts: write separate files; never overwrite a failed result
